Responsibilities & Context
PRAN-RFL Group, one of the most diversified and innovation-driven conglomerates in Bangladesh, is seeking talented and dynamic professionals for the position of Management Trainee Officer – Brand. With a strong legacy of excellence, we continue to lead in delivering quality, value, and innovation across a wide range of industries.
This role offers aspiring professionals the opportunity to gain hands-on experience in brand management, marketing strategy, and consumer engagement. The selected candidate will work closely with senior brand managers and cross-functional teams to learn, contribute, and grow into a future leader in the marketing function.
Job Responsibilities:
Support the formulation and implementation of ATL (Above-the-Line), BTL (Below-the-Line), and TTL (Through-the-Line) marketing strategies to enhance brand visibility, strengthen market presence, and improve consumer engagement.
Contribute to the planning, development, and execution of integrated brand campaigns aligned with organizational objectives, market trends, and consumer insights.
Collaborate with creative agencies, media partners, and internal stakeholders to ensure timely, effective, and high-quality execution of brand initiatives.
Conduct deep-dive research to track industry trends, analyze consumer behavior, and benchmark competitors, providing insights that guide strategic decision-making.
Deliver actionable insights to support product positioning, promotional planning, and market entry strategies, ensuring alignment with business goals.
Assist in tracking, analyzing, and reporting brand performance metrics, preparing regular dashboards and reports for senior management.
Contribute to developing and executing brand differentiation strategies to build and sustain strong brand equity.
Assist in product innovation activities, including packaging development, pricing strategies, and promotional planning to maintain market competitiveness.

Market standard salary (Review after 6 months probation period based on performance)

Mobile bill, Tour allowance, and Provident fund

raw_source_fields.deadline: s. Good communication and reporting skills in both Bangla and English. Ability to work independently as well as effectively within a team. Responsibilities & Context General Information Project Name: The Meaningful Participation and Inclusion of Children and Youth with Disabilities in All Domains of CBR (MaPInCBR) Implementing Organization: Samprity Protibandhi Unnayan Sangstha (SPUS) Partner Organization: Centre for Disability in Development (CDD) Proposed Contract Period: Up to December 2026 Justification for Recruitment The recruitment of an Accounts & Admin Officer is required to ensure effective financial and administrative management of the MaPInCBR project. The position will be responsible for maintaining accurate financial records and documentation, processing bills and vouchers, monitoring project expenditures against the approved budget, preparing financial reports, supporting procurement and administrative functions, and ensuring compliance with the organization’s financial policies and applicable donor requirements. The position is essential for ensuring transparency, accountability, timely financial reporting, proper documentation, and smooth day-to-day financial and administrative operations of the project. Key Responsibilities and Duties The Accounts & Admin Officer will be responsible for the following: Maintain accurate and up-to-date books of accounts and financial records of the project. Verify, process, and properly maintain all bills, vouchers, receipts, and other financial documents. Monitor project expenditures against the approved budget and prepare necessary financial statements and analyses. Prepare monthly and quarterly financial reports as required. Maintain and regularly update the cash book, ledger, bank book, and other relevant accounting records. Carry out banking activities, cheque/payment processing, and other necessary financial transactions. Support and facilitate project procurement and administrative activities in accordance with organizational policies and procedures. Maintain records of office assets, stationery, supplies, and other project materials. Maintain staff attendance, leave records, and other relevant administrative documents. Prepare and maintain necessary supporting documents and records for internal and external audits. Ensure compliance with the project’s financial procedures, SPUS Financial Policy, approved budget, and relevant donor compliance requirements. Perform any other financial and administrative duties assigned by the appropriate authority in relation to the project.

Gain knowledge of company policies, procedures and operational processes. Maintain proper notes and communicate effectively with Managers and Supervisors. Fulfill the learning objectives and goals set for the traineeship. Perform other duties assigned by the Production Management.
